nodes.title: On the merged tree of integration 72 an authored picture caption was said whatever second view was drawn: a bar card whose view was a number line got the caption written for its circle. Brain's wiring found the caption by its board; Learning writes each caption against the one view the board's own second view draws. Each stream's gate passed alone (Brain had no captions, Learning no wiring); an older test (r7-brain-v6-altview) caught it on the merged tree. Fixed by main: viewCaptionOf takes the kind of the view drawn and says no caption over another kind.

The browser suites run only in the main loop's local gate: stream environments have no browser and CI does not run them. Integration 71's gate failed on the tally layout browser suite (a state assertion stale after gate 2 H4; the screen was unchanged), and the kon layout suite does not render the new acute and tilted levels. A push to int/r6 now needs the local full run as well as CI.

tests/r4-games-core-patch03.test.mjs set the Studio seam's database stub (a database that answers with no rows) and never put it back; in a shared process stagecraft's phone-play test then found no play piece. An old latent leak that the day's seed (20261116) put in one process. Found by bisecting the failing leak process (177 files); fixed by restoring the seam's deps.

Integration 72 (0c9378866: Brain cb21c01b R2, T2, captions wired, H2, boards, K2, part of A2; Learning 3e25c5c60 captions and the director23 list; Games 493262853 discriminating levels and the level mix): CI green, local test:all 7,392 pass, 0 fail (754 suites), leak check clean. Dry matrix 0 on every gated predicate, pending repeatedAuthored 8; 16 picture requests, 16 views, 1 quiet picture line (c4 offtopic row 26), 28 cards said again within two turns, 67 turns over 60 words. Released as release 39.
